title: BEST CRIMINALITY SCRIPT / RAGEBOT / ESP / LEGIT
features:
COMBAT SYSTEMS
Silent Aim
Bullet redirection to target body parts with configurable FOV (10-750), hit chance, wall check, and mouse or centre targeting. FOV circle customizable with colors, glow, spin, and fill.

Aimbot
Auto-aim with smooth transitions. Separate X/Y smoothness, multiple aim curves (Linear, Expo, EaseIn, EaseOut, Cubic, Instant), hold or toggle keybind.

Triggerbot
Auto-fires on target. Delay, hit chance, semi or burst modes, burst count, and kill cooldown adjustable.

Ragebot
Auto-targets and fires with wallbang capability. Hit part options (Head, Torso, HumanoidRootPart, Closest, Random), target sorting (Nearest, Farthest, Lowest HP, Highest HP, Random), priority targeting.

Melee Bot
Auto-swings melee weapons at enemies. Target part selection, animation toggle, chainsaw support.

Anti-Aim
Multi-mode desync: Ball (limbs collapse), Hide Head, Spinbot, Face Down, Face Up. Rotation speed adjustable.

Underground Desync
Teleports below map. Height, pitch, yaw, roll adjustable. Randomize axes. Visualizer shows desync position.

VISUAL FEATURES
Player ESP
Box ESP (2D or corner) with glow, gradient or solid fill. Name, distance, flags (moving, jumping, sprinting, crouching, downed, etc.), weapon, health bar, armor bar, ammo bar. All colors customizable.

Chams
Glow-through-walls with fill/outline color and transparency control. Glow chams with X-ray shaded body parts.

Bullet Tracers
40+ styles. Color, thickness, lifetime adjustable. Hit/miss color differentiation.

Hit Effects
Hitsounds (100+ sounds). Hit particles (bubble, sparks, orbs, air) with colors. Damage numbers with split animation, font, size, duration control.

Custom Crosshair
Mouse, centre, or muzzle positioning. Spin animation with speed/style. Resize animation with min/max. Follow ragebot target with lerp.

World Visuals
Skybox changer (16+ presets, custom images). Time of day slider. Ambient, bloom (intensity/size/threshold), blur, fog (color/start/end), color correction (brightness/contrast/saturation/tint), sun rays, shadows.

Weather
Snow, rain, blizzard. Intensity, rate, speed, size, spread, particle color adjustable.

Misc ESP
Labels for dropped tools, cash drops, scrap piles, ATMs, vending machines, mystery boxes, dealers, safes. Name/distance toggles with custom colors.

MOVEMENT FEATURES
Ragdoll Fly with speed control (10-150)

Always Sprint with stamina top-up

Silent Walk (mutes footsteps)

No Fall Damage

Auto-use Energy Drink at threshold

Auto-Med at health threshold

Auto-Unlock Doors

Auto-Unlock Safe

Infinite Stamina

No ADS Slowdown

Walk Speed Multiplier (1-3x) with keybind

Instant Proximity Prompts

WEAPON MODIFICATIONS
No Recoil

No Spread (adjustable amount 0-1)

Rapid Fire (configurable rate)

Force Full Auto

Bullet Multiplier (1-7 shots)

Always Headshot

No Muzzle Flash

No Bullet Tracers

Fast Equip

Auto-Reload

Invalid Shot on Miss (ammo refund)

ANTI-EFFECTS
Anti-Flashbang (blocks flash effects)

Anti-Shellshock (blocks concussion)

No Flinch (prevents aim punch)

Anti Down (instantly recovers from ragdoll)

USER INTERFACE
Controls
Toggles, sliders, dropdowns (single/multi), color pickers (with alpha, hex/RGB input, copy/paste), textboxes, buttons (with confirm), keybind pickers, lists, curve editors, viewport previews, dialogs.

Watermark
FPS, ping, game name, user ID, player name, date. Refresh rate and visible components configurable.

Target HUD
